description: Graph relationship types. Reprojection fails for an unregistered relation. No relation establishes causality.

relations.description: Completed single dose refers to its medication identity, without implying an ongoing regimen.
Resource or document belongs to the patient chart.
Medication change event refers to the medication identity it changes.
Resource is documented by a searchable source document or excerpt.
Reviewed record quotes this user message verbatim. Provenance only.
Resource is an instance of an ontology record category.
Message order within a conversation session.
Local user account owns the patient profile.
Message belongs to a conversation session.
Parsed laboratory observation belongs to its source report.
Patient hypothesis refers to a medication. Causality is not established.
Records from different providers may describe the same event. A review candidate, never a merge.
Patient care preference refers to a medication.
Record refers to, clarifies or provides context for another record without changing it.
Patient-reported association between records. Causality is not established.
Patient-reported response refers to a medication. Causality is not established.
Symptom reported as persisting during a treatment.
Symptom reported as present before a treatment.
Patient-reported response followed a specific dose. Temporal only; causality is not established.
Symptom the patient reports a treatment was intended to address.
Demographic report describes the patient.
Systolic and diastolic values come from the same blood pressure reading.
Explicit patient correction replaces an earlier measurement of the same metric and date; the earlier report is retained.
